Subject: COI & MSA redlines — requested coverage and timeline

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for your time on the call this morning. We’re close on commercial terms — attached is the COI request form Northbound requires for new vendors plus the current set of redlines our legal team (Alex) proposed to the MSA. High level asks:

- Coverage minimums per our procurement policy (see attached)
  - CGL: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
  - Professional Liability / E&O: $2,000,000
  - Cyber/Privacy: $2,000,000 (incl. breach response)
  - Commercial Auto: $1,000,000 (if vehicles used)
  - Workers’ Comp: statutory
- Additional insured: Northbound Technologies, its parent and affiliates; endorsement naming required on primary CGL policy
- Primary & non-contributory language and waiver of subrogation for CGL and Auto; retroactive date for Professional Liability to match contract effective date

We need a CI (certificate of insurance) and draft endorsement language by Friday 2027-04-23 to keep the onboarding timeline. Our broker (Jamie) is looped in — happy to accept a carrier-produced endorsement if it matches the sample.

Two specific asks:
1) Can Redwood accept an endorsement limited to naming Northbound and its direct parent (not all customers)? If not, please state what you can do.
2) If you need an internal exception to limits or wording, what is the escalation path and expected lead time?

Appreciate a quick confirmation.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Owens
Vendor Manager | Northbound Technologies

Subject: Re: COI & MSA redlines — requested coverage and timeline

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and attachments. We can meet the numeric coverage minimums listed above for CGL, E&O, Auto, and cyber. A few notes on the endorsement and scope:

- Redwood’s broker can produce an endorsement naming Northbound and Northbound, Inc. (our standard practice is to limit to named additional insured entities rather than open-ended "its customers"). If you need the broader "and its customers" language we’ll need to route to Legal and Carrier for approval — that typically takes 7–10 business days.
- Primary & non-contributory + waiver of subrogation for CGL/Auto: acceptable. We will request primary wording from the carrier; if carrier refuses, we’ll escalate to exec procurement for an exception.
- Retroactive date: we can confirm retro active dating for our current retro policy; if your contract requires retroactive date = contract effective, we’ll need confirmation from our carrier.

We’ll aim to deliver a draft COI and a sample endorsement by Thursday EOD (2027-04-22). If carrier sign-off is required for expanded additional-insured language, I’ll flag that same day and propose the fallback: temporary COI naming Northbound only + written plan to secure endorsement within 10 business days.

Looping David for carrier contact and Kim for legal redline review. Aditya — please hold the DocuSign envelope until we confirm endorsement language so we don’t mis-sign.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference

Alex/Sarah — thanks for the redlines. Quick notes after an initial pass:

- Section 7.2 (Indemnity): the proposed addition that requires Redwood to name all of Northbound’s customers as additional insured is broader than our standard. We can accept naming Northbound and Northbound Holdings, but not every downstream customer. If the request is non-negotiable for the customer, please have procurement provide a business justification to route for an underwriter exception.
- Section 9.1 (Insurance): add an explicit carve-in that Professional Liability covers intellectual property claims arising out of services — we usually provide this but want to ensure the language maps to E&O coverage rather than CGL.
- Section 9.4 (Certificate delivery): propose language for a 10 business day delivery window for COI after effective date; we will also commit to making the endorsement reasonable within 10 business days of carrier sign-off.

If you’re open to the compromise above (Northbound + holdings only), we can get the COI and draft endorsement on Thursday and expedite the carrier confirmation for primary/non-contributory/waiver.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Contracts Counsel | Redwood Inference
